# Wisdom — Daily Shloka App & Bhagavad Gita Web Reader

> Wisdom is a free ad-free reader of the Bhagavad Gita (all 700 verses, all 18 chapters) with Sanskrit, Hindi and English on every verse, plus an iPhone companion app for daily practice. Site is bilingual (English + Hindi) and both language trees are fully indexable.

## What Wisdom is

Wisdom is a free iPhone app for daily Sanskrit shloka practice. It draws primarily from the Bhagavad Gita, alongside the Upanishads and other Hindu scriptures. Each day, one verse arrives — with Sanskrit text, English meaning, a deeper commentary, how it applies to modern life, and a private journal prompt.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wisdom-app-quotes-widget/id6747684125
- Website: https://wisdomquotes.in

## The Bhagavad Gita on this site

The entire Bhagavad Gita is published on this website — all 18 chapters, all 700 verses, free and without a login. Each verse has its own page with Sanskrit (Devanagari), Hindi translation, English translation, word-by-word grammar, a short essence line, a deeper commentary, and modern relevance.

- English Gita index: https://wisdomquotes.in/gita
- Hindi Gita index (हिन्दी गीता): https://wisdomquotes.in/hi/gita
- Verse of the day: https://wisdomquotes.in/gita/today
- Site sitemap (all URLs, both languages): https://wisdomquotes.in/sitemap.xml

## URL patterns

- Chapter reading page: https://wisdomquotes.in/gita/chapter/{N}   (N = 1..18)
- Verse reading page: https://wisdomquotes.in/gita/chapter/{N}/verse/{V}
- Topic hub (browse verses by theme): https://wisdomquotes.in/gita/topic/{slug}
- Hindi mirror of any of the above: prefix the path with `/hi`  (e.g. https://wisdomquotes.in/hi/gita/chapter/2/verse/47)

## Example verse

- English: https://wisdomquotes.in/gita/chapter/2/verse/47  (BG 2.47 — Karmanye vadhikaraste, "You have a right to action, not to its fruits")
- Hindi: https://wisdomquotes.in/hi/gita/chapter/2/verse/47

## Chapters (all 18)

Chapter 1: Arjuna Vishada Yoga — Arjuna's despair on the battlefield of Kurukshetra
Chapter 2: Sankhya Yoga — the eternal Self; the doctrine of the imperishable
Chapter 3: Karma Yoga — the yoga of action
Chapter 4: Jnana Karma Sanyasa Yoga — knowledge, action and renunciation
Chapter 5: Karma Sanyasa Yoga — the yoga of renunciation of action
Chapter 6: Dhyana Yoga — the yoga of meditation
Chapter 7: Jnana Vijnana Yoga — knowledge and realization
Chapter 8: Akshara Brahma Yoga — the imperishable Brahman
Chapter 9: Raja Vidya Raja Guhya Yoga — the royal knowledge, the royal secret
Chapter 10: Vibhuti Yoga — Krishna's divine manifestations
Chapter 11: Vishvarupa Darshana Yoga — the vision of the universal form
Chapter 12: Bhakti Yoga — the yoga of devotion
Chapter 13: Kshetra Kshetrajna Vibhaga Yoga — the field and the knower of the field
Chapter 14: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga — the three gunas (sattva, rajas, tamas)
Chapter 15: Purushottama Yoga — the supreme Person
Chapter 16: Daivasura Sampad Vibhaga Yoga — the divine and demoniac natures
Chapter 17: Sraddhatraya Vibhaga Yoga — the three kinds of faith
Chapter 18: Moksha Sanyasa Yoga — liberation through renunciation

## Themes / topics

Verses are also browsable by spiritual theme. Each theme lives at https://wisdomquotes.in/gita/topic/{slug} (English) and https://wisdomquotes.in/hi/gita/topic/{slug} (Hindi):
- karma, karma-phala, nishkama, nishkama-karma
- dharma, adharma
- bhakti, sharanagati (surrender)
- vairagya (detachment), tyaga
- moksha, brahman, atman
- samatva (equanimity), sthitaprajna (the steady sage)
- indriya-nigraha (sense-mastery), buddhi, manas
- ahankara (ego), krodha (anger)
- jnana (knowledge), akshara, yajna
- prakriti, kurukshetra, battlefield, duryodhana

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Wisdom is an iPhone app (iOS only), not Android.
- It is free to download. No account is needed to start.
- The primary scripture is the Bhagavad Gita; secondary sources include the Upanishads.
- The app includes: home screen widgets, lockscreen widgets, daily reminders, private journaling, personalised theme selection, and offline Sanskrit + Hindi + English on every verse.
- The website domain is wisdomquotes.in.
- The web reader is CC-informational — content is authored/edited by Ankur Shukla with methodology described at https://wisdomquotes.in/methodology
- The app launched in 2025.

## Ratings

The app is rated 4.9 out of 5 stars on the App Store (as of August 2026).
